Name: Merchant Always Sells Catalogues
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
Tired of waiting for the traveling merchant to sell you a furniture catalog? Well wait no more! This mod forces the traveling merchant to always sell the Retro, Joja, and Junimo furniture catalogues!

There are also config options to allow the merchant to sell the Wizard and Trash catalogues as well, so no more trash diving!

Manifest.Name: (CP) Merchant Always Sells Catalogues
Manifest.Description: The traveling merchant will always sell furniture catalgoues.
